decisions.reason: The optional tip controls do not change the fixed $15 mint price or any established per-sale revenue allocation.
The accepted tipping controls do not change the Transak provider, fiat-to-USDC flow, or supported fiat payment methods.
The source approves mint-page tipping controls but does not require corresponding FAQ copy.
Tip amount controls do not affect referral-code identity, lifetime, sharing, display, or resale behavior.
Optional primary-mint tips do not alter the enabled flat secondary-sale royalty.
The tipping presets and custom-tip option do not change commission allocation when no referral code is supplied.
The source does not change the $5 referral commission, its trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or earning limits.
The approved tipping controls do not change Big Block prize amounts, draw rules, funding, or ticket behavior.
The source does not require tip information to appear in NFT metadata or alter any existing metadata attribute.
Mint tipping does not change which NFT entitlements, referral identity, badges, or tickets transfer on resale.
The approved tipping controls do not change Small Block prize amounts, draw rules, funding, or ticket behavior.
Adding optional tip controls leaves the unlimited-mint NFT ebook collection model unchanged.
